description: This file contains the implementation of an AWS partition, including methods for handling endpoints, regions, and services within a specific cloud partition.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Represents an AWS partition with methods for endpoint resolution and region matching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Partition object with definitions including regions, services, and DNS suffix.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the partition.

methods.name: getDnsSuffix
methods.description: Returns the DNS suffix associated with the partition.

methods.name: isRegionMatch
methods.description: Checks if a region matches a service or region regex within the partition.

methods.name: getAvailableEndpoints
methods.description: Returns a list of available endpoints for a specified service, considering regional or global endpoints.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Generates an endpoint URL and metadata based on provided parameters like service and region.

methods.name: getEndpointData
methods.description: Retrieves endpoint configuration data for a given service and region.

methods.name: getSignatureVersion
methods.description: Determines the signature version for a given endpoint data.

methods.name: resolveRegion
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate region, considering special endpoint types and settings.

methods.name: isServicePartitionGlobal
methods.description: Determines if a service is globally partitioned.

methods.name: isStsLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if STS legacy endpoint handling is applicable for a region.

methods.name: isS3LegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if S3 legacy endpoint handling is applicable for a region.

methods.name: getPartitionEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves a partition endpoint for a specific service.

methods.name: formatEndpoint
methods.description: Formats an endpoint URL based on a template and parameters.

methods.name: isFipsEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if the region uses a FIPS-specific endpoint.

methods.name: getVariant
methods.description: Determines endpoint variants like FIPS or dual-stack based on options.
